about:
The printed editions' foot (seer) divisions, read from the OCR word boxes. The 1885, 1886 and Navalar prints set
each kural in its metrical division (அகர முதல வெழுத்தெல்லா மாதி); the OCR keeps one box per printed word, so the box
changes mark where the print breaks the feet. For each kural and print: locate the kural (scan_locations), split
the located letters at box changes, and split the lines at the largest vertical jump (after the fourth word when there
are seven). Only the break positions are used (tkcore.prosody.scan projects them onto the core letters); the OCR
letters are never used as text. A division is used only when the location is reliable (the print's 90th-percentile match ratio) and it has 4 + 3 words.
